title: I AM UNWELL!!!! #mcctheater #bridgesofmadisoncounty #theatrekids #jas...
transcript: It's the way I immediately burst into tears when I got this email. MCC Theatre is doing a one night only benefit concert of The Bridges of Madison County. Almost the entire original cast. I can't. Not to mention a 20 piece orchestra playing an expanded version of the score with Jason Robert Brown conducting himself. The bridges of Madison County is one of my favorite musicals of all time. I think I saw it five times on Broadway, which was a huge deal for me back then. It is a score that I return to often. I cannot believe this is happening. I never thought I'd get to hear Kelly and Steven sing this again. Falling into you one second & a million miles. I'm already crying and Whitney singing another life. Can't wait to see my favorite teenagers. This is just such a good cast. Show is going to be December 15th at seven PM at Carnegie Hall. Will I be there? I hope so! If you're an MCC Patron you can get a ticket right now. Otherwise tickets go on sale October 3rd. Support MCC Theatre. Go see the bridges of Madison County I'm losing my mind.
